grammar.why: Pashto nouns ending in "ay/ai" are usually feminine: کتاب/کړکۍ مؤنث دي۔

grammar.why: Pashto negates with "na" before the verb.

Pashto is SOV — the verb is last.

grammar.why: Adjectives come before the noun: لوی کور.
